data.thought: The model CR-001 shows significant issues, particularly with segments performing poorly and a high number of no-decisions in fuzz testing. The stress test indicated some decision flips, but the challenger tool failed due to insufficient data. Further investigation is warranted before concluding.
reasons: Challenger tool failed due to insufficient data, indicating potential issues with model robustness.
High number of no-decisions in fuzz testing suggests the model may not handle edge cases well.
